weight_source.supervision: Whole car/truck boxes in separate supervised RGB detector training only; no control GT.

detector.inference_inputs: rendered RGB only; no GT or HSV
detector.timing_scope: synchronized CUDA wall time including preprocessing, forward, postprocessing and Detection conversion
detector.difference_from_paper: Ultralytics model with UE GPU domain adaptation, not author MMDetection detector
detector.truck_box_definition: Learned full cab+cargo+chassis RGB detection; no GT expansion
detector.truck_duplicate_rule: Suppress lower-support truck parts covered>=70% by a >=1.35xarea truck box atconf>=max(.5,.8*partconfidence). Applied to raw fast path and multiscale fusion. Never enlarges or merges coordinates.
detector.fovea: RGB/camera predictedROI, coldquadrants, no GT or scenevelocity
detector.fast_path: FullRGB each observation; crop recovery when lockedtarget lacks nearby>=.55confidence detection, independent of othervehicleconfidence. RGB/owncamera prediction only.

reid.name: FastReID_SBS_R50_IBN_VeRi_official_release
reid.architecture: ResNet50 + IBN + 5 nonlocal blocks + GeM + BN neck
reid.refresh_rule: Strong consecutive singlecandidate RGBassociation: cachedfeature<=150ms; ambiguous/lowconfidence/lost/new reset forcesrealReID; weights unchanged.

motion.usage: Scene metadata only, never supplied to control.

architecture: Freshly trained precision15 P-DQN, explicit RGB engineering mask/duration/scale bounds, continuous single-owner perception.
online_overlay: Exact fresh processedRGBframe+actualonline box, rendered duringrun. No interpolation, boxreplay or postrun inference.
action_semantics: Every motorpulse fullycompletes; nextcommand consumes an actual perception result withsource time>=nativeactionend andremaining=0. Perception alsoprocesses midpulse frames.
perception_profile: Original FP32 full detection each processed frame, fresh FP32 ReID every candidate; multi-frame local turn reassociation with angular ownership and duplicate-fragment protection.
startup_scale: First lock of each target generation: roughly centre, then actively zoom toward1.6% area. Finish at>=1.44%;2% upper guard unchanged. Fresh RGB feedback between exclusive pulses.
native_stream_metadata: Dynamic same-frame state only; full immutable configuration saved in initial-native-state.json and scene.json.
identity_association: Joint assignment; angular/established ownership; nominal locked ReID>=.70; unique local turn recovery: 2 strong-gallery frames or 3 high-confidence adjacent-crop confirmations; gallery>=.60 plus adjacent-crop ReID>=.90 for view change, tight geometry and age<=.15s for normal short-term links; age<=.35s for turn confirmation; short-term-only/recovery links cannot update appearance bank; merged/duplicate-fragment protection.
motion_gain: Declared engineering bound: per-frame RGB/Kalman bearing speed>.8deg/s permits minimum pan/tilt opticsgain.18;>.35 permits.10. Neural15state/per-command history unchanged. Remaining-image-error duration cap still applies.
search_scale: Last visible angular size limits widening to keep predicted box area>=.0015; no predicted boxes are drawn.
centering_governor: Balance axes; maximum .28s unserved significant-axis wait; bounded half-feedback motion lead; acquire large-error duration floor <=100ms; mechanical/area/exclusive-pulse limits retained.
